title: Vitron: A Unified Pixel-level Vision LLM for Understanding, Generating, Segmenting, Editing

layout.note: Four tinted quadrants in a 2 by 2 grid, placed by two gradient block arrows on the top and left edges, with the VITRON logo in a white disc over the central junction; each quadrant holds titled tabs over thumbnails in rows.
